statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-34040 is an authorization-plugin bypass in the Moby server's API request handling. The ai-collaboration-workbench image contains no Docker daemon and uses Docker only as a client of the daemon supplied through DOCKER_HOST. github.com/docker/docker is linked into the Buildx client binary, whose source-build dependency check rejects github.com/docker/docker/api/server and github.com/docker/docker/daemon packages. The authorization-plugin request path is therefore absent from the image's executable code.

statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-41567 is in the Moby daemon's PUT /containers/{id}/archive implementation, where the server can resolve archive-decompression helpers from a container filesystem. The ai-collaboration-workbench image contains no Docker daemon and uses Docker only as a client of the daemon supplied through DOCKER_HOST. github.com/docker/docker is linked into the Buildx client binary, whose source-build dependency check rejects github.com/docker/docker/api/server and github.com/docker/docker/daemon packages. The vulnerable daemon archive-upload path is therefore absent from the image's executable code.

statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-42306 is a race in the Moby daemon's docker cp bind-mount setup that can redirect a mount to a host path. The ai-collaboration-workbench image contains no Docker daemon and uses Docker only as a client of the daemon supplied through DOCKER_HOST. github.com/docker/docker is linked into the Buildx client binary, whose source-build dependency check rejects github.com/docker/docker/api/server and github.com/docker/docker/daemon packages. The vulnerable bind-mount and archive-server path is therefore absent from the image's executable code.
